Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: Off-by-one interpretation in the implementation. The code returns the loop counter (the number of iterations performed) when round(x_n,4) == round(x_{n+1},4), which corresponds to the higher index in the pair. The question asks for the smallest n such that x_n and x_{n+1} match when rounded to four decimals. In this case, the equality occurs between x2 and x3, so the correct smallest n is 2, but the script (and final answer) reported 3.
